name: @unlock-velocity/shared-pos-ui
//: The host admin supplies every one of these at runtime - there is one React, one Mantine and one Next in the page, and a second copy of any of them breaks hooks and context. They are peers for that reason, and dev dependencies only so this package can type-check itself.
//types: Pinned to the exact versions both admins install. These files are compiled by the admin's own TypeScript through a symlink, so the admin sees this package's nested @types/react and csstype as a SECOND set of React declarations. Newer ones are not structurally identical - csstype 3.2 widened CSSProperties - and every style prop then fails to type-check in the admin. Bump these only together with the admins.
//ao: The AO till is a separate entry point so hosts that do not render it do not bundle it. `exports` covers bundlers; `typesVersions` covers the admins' older `moduleResolution: node`, which ignores an exports map entirely.
